name: splat
description: Cross-platform building blocks for .NET applications. Provides service location and dependency resolution, logging, platform-neutral images, colours and geometry, and unit test and design mode detection.

discussions.title: How to integrate with Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection and WPF before Application object is created

latest_release.body:
## 🗞️ What's Changed

### ✨ Features
 * reactiveui/splat@8cfe76a7b7023f4c1be72113a20cff2b7d77ee96 feat(skiasharp): add a Skia bitmap loader package (#1674) @glennawatson

### 🐛 Fixes
 * reactiveui/splat@4639f7b7d7594b4c3bbb1b81ca027dac15ea0224 fix(drawing): honour the requested size when decoding on Android and Cocoa (#1673) @glennawatson
 * reactiveui/splat@f110782f393e8c02621b6307cf64876be30a2c2d fix(drawing): keep the aspect ratio when a decode size is requested (#1669) @glennawatson
 * reactiveui/splat@9e63cc0bdbabb8b90bea06f5d0730eb054de0f7d fix(simpleinjector): key registrations by contract and stop dropping Register (#1670) @glennawatson
 * reactiveui/splat@b01291d8c03f01f987d99f1ee8abcd5b504e26ae fix(drawing): report design mode correctly for nested WPF user controls (#1671) @glennawatson
 * reactiveui/splat@e95e515278a2652768c50563945bd6e8052b196c fix(core): confine WithResolver to the calling flow (#1672) @glennawatson

### 🧹 General Changes
 * reactiveui/splat@5f8bd5bc4b6d3de84f30cd9fd16748a61647ebee build: adopt PublicApiSharp public API baselines and LF line endings (#1667) @glennawatson
 * reactiveui/splat@b1d3f1413aaf42abdcb629d710ea33861f89be1e build: refresh dependencies and adopt the shared analyzer rule set (#1668) @glennawatson
 * reactiveui/splat@55661aebc6ce6c46cd3817d71adde8bf9fce5e14 chore(renovate): group related dependency cohorts (#1662) @glennawatson

### 📦 Dependencies
 * reactiveui/splat@efda08fea9eb6cda2dc88480993aa02199b45a83 chore(deps): update dependency tunit to 1.62.0 (#1666) @renovate[bot]
 * reactiveui/splat@710b7fa971aca0c96d28609d594046d5c65633dd chore(deps): update dependency microsoft.testing.platform.msbuild to 2.3.3 (#1665) @renovate[bot]
 * reactiveui/splat@001d07b1d994147be51b7dcfac2c7f4d2fcefb76 chore(deps): update dependency tunit to 1.61.38 (#1654) @renovate[bot]
 * reactiveui/splat@7c969331c00263959eb2548961148a3396766ea9 chore(deps): update dependency reactiveui.disposables to 7.1.0 (#1656) @renovate[bot]
 * reactiveui/splat@aae4a77777ed98af1af772c45b74642bc2723ca2 chore(deps): update dependency performancesharp.analyzers to 3.39.0 (#1657) @renovate[bot]
 * reactiveui/splat@61a4013eb9b0b9a0db3ec65eda169d4523c450fa chore(deps): update dependency stylesharp.analyzers to 3.39.0 (#1659) @renovate[bot]

🔗 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/reactiveui/splat/compare/v20.2.0...v21.0.0
